name: tradeflow
description: TradeFlow MVP - a real-time trading simulator (modular monolith).

scripts.build: npm run build -w @tradeflow/shared-types && npm run build -w @tradeflow/api && npm run build -w @tradeflow/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @tradeflow/api && npm run lint -w @tradeflow/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @tradeflow/shared-types && npm run typecheck -w @tradeflow/api && npm run typecheck -w @tradeflow/web
